code.description:
The problem code of its error (`SH1002`), or of its failure when
it ran and failed on the setup (`doctor`); `shuyi explain <code>`
prints its page.

error.description: Why it could not run, if it could not.

help.description: How to fix it, with the code.

limits.description: What it could not determine, in plain words.

ok.description:
Whether it passed: nothing found by a check, runs that agree, a
game made, a toolchain complete. False too when it could not run.

result.description: What it found or made; absent when it could not run.

hits.description: The chunks it matched, best first, then by path and position.

how.description: The "how do I" rows the query asked, in the table's order.

Hit.description: A chunk of the docs that the query matched.

anchor.description:
Its section's anchor in the page (`naming-a-key-in-text`); none at a
page's start.

excerpt.description:
Its text from where it first holds the query's rarest term, at most
400 bytes, with `…` where it was cut.

path.description:
Its source in the engine's repository
(`site/content/learn/book/actions.md`).

score.description:
How well it matched: BM25 in thousandths. Higher is better; only
comparable within one answer.

title.description: Its page's or skill's title, and its section's heading.

url.description:
The Markdown twin of its Learn page on the engine's site; none for
other kinds.

HowRow.description: A row of the "how do I" table whose task the query asked.

anchor.description: Its section's anchor, if it names one.

ask.description: The row's task phrase the query holds (`play a sound`).

go.description:
Where it is answered, as the table writes it
(`learn/book/games-and-screens.md#the-context`, `skill/shuyi-input`,
`example/hello-grid/src/lib.rs`).

path.description: Its source in the engine's repository.

url.description: The Markdown twin of its Learn page; none for other kinds.
